verdict.rationale: The dot's own documented capability is to use background agents to work on several things in parallel and to delegate parts of a request to ChatGPT Work or Codex. That gives it some native ability to act on multiple items at once, but the evidence never describes applying one operation across many items in bulk. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation support (one action applied across many items), documented limits or scale, examples of bulk edits across connected apps, independent or hands-on corroboration.
